title: BACKGROUND CHANGE ONLY - WHITE
prompt:
BACKGROUND CHANGE ONLY

## IMAGE ASSIGNMENT

Image 1 (Primary Image): The image to be edited.
[   ]

---

# BACKGROUND REPLACEMENT ONLY

Modify only the background of Image 1.

The subject must remain completely unchanged.

Remove the existing background and replace it with a realistic indoor environment consisting of a completely white room.

The room must appear as though it was professionally photographed rather than digitally generated.

---

# NEW ENVIRONMENT

Replace the original background with a clean, minimalist white room.

The environment must include:

• Completely smooth white walls.
• A completely white floor.
• A seamless transition between walls and floor whenever possible.
• No visible wall decorations.
• No paintings.
• No windows.
• No doors.
• No furniture.
• No mirrors.
• No shelves.
• No objects.
• No textures.
• No patterns.
• No architectural distractions.

The room should feel spacious, modern, elegant, and minimalistic.

The white surfaces should contain a very subtle cool tint rather than a warm yellow tone.

---

# LIGHTING

Recalculate the lighting of the entire scene so that it naturally matches the new environment.

Create soft, diffused studio-quality illumination.

The lighting should appear to originate naturally from the white room.

Maintain realistic shadows and light falloff.

Avoid harsh shadows.

Avoid overexposure.

Avoid dramatic contrast.

Maintain soft natural skin tones.

Ensure the lighting integrates perfectly with the subject.

---

# ABSOLUTE PRIORITY

Preserve the model exactly as she appears in Image 1.

Under no circumstances modify:

• Facial identity.
• Face shape.
• Facial expression.
• Eyes.
• Eyebrows.
• Nose.
• Lips.
• Jawline.
• Cheekbones.
• Ears.
• Hairstyle.
• Hair length.
• Hair volume.
• Hair color.
• Makeup.
• Skin tone.
• Body proportions.
• Anatomy.
• Pose.
• Hand position.
• Finger position.
• Clothing.
• Footwear.
• Jewelry.
• Accessories.

The subject must remain pixel-for-pixel identical whenever possible.

---

# PRESERVE IMAGE CHARACTERISTICS

Maintain exactly:

• Camera position.
• Camera angle.
• Camera distance.
• Perspective.
• Framing.
• Composition.
• Depth of field.
• Sharpness.
• Color grading.
• Photographic realism.
• Image quality.

Only replace the background and adapt the lighting so that the subject blends naturally into the new environment.

---

# RESTRICTIONS

Do not change the pose.

Do not rotate the body.

Do not alter the clothing.

Do not alter the hairstyle.

Do not alter the facial expression.

Do not move the subject.

Do not zoom in.

Do not zoom out.

Do not crop the image.

Do not modify the framing.

Do not introduce any objects.

Do not introduce furniture.

Do not introduce decorations.

Do not introduce architectural elements that distract from the subject.

---

# FINAL OBJECTIVE

The final image must appear as though the original photograph was captured inside a professional minimalist white studio room with soft, cool, diffused lighting while preserving the subject exactly as she appears in the original image.
